## Post-merge performance receipt — F209 part 1

Deployed merge **`f06f00f56b30f0ea8c7e6e37c37ea5cba283329c`**, daemon **PID68910**; ping reported `commit=f06f00f56b`. Waited until daemon uptime **02:30** before the minute sample. No seat closed/reloaded; `pij-musical-hedgehog` remained open and its process was active.

**Result:** the missing-transcript state lookup is fast; daemon CPU is lower than the earlier observation, but **the roughly<20%CPU target is not met by this part-1 reading**. Part2 (#251, held-delivery history replay) was not deployed in this window. These are separate live observations, not a controlled attribution of the entire CPU difference to #249.

### Settled minute

`/usr/bin/top -l 7 -s 10 -pid 68910 -stats pid,command,cpu,time,mem`; first cumulative sample excluded. Six interval CPU samples (% of one core): **21.7,24.2,21.2,24.4,23.7,19.4**; mean **22.43%**.

| Receipt | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| UTC |2026-11-19 02:26:22.613|2026-11-19 02:27:26.156|
| Daemon uptime |02:30|03:34|
| CPU time (`ps`) |0:53.08|1:07.61|
| RSS (`ps`,KiB) |161856|147584|
| Daemon spawn counter |420|431|
| Placement-git counter (absent=0) |0|0|

CPU time increased **14.53s over63.542s =22.87% of one core**. Spawn delta **+11**: `git.community`+7, `ddocs.community`+2, `ps.tmux-harness-process-tree`+2; all other observed operation deltas0. This is not a zero-launch claim.

Separate `just spawn-rate --seconds 20` receipt: whole-machine **148.3 launches/s**, sampled **143.2/s**, observed daemon-child lower bound **{}**. This other-fleet-inclusive window is not the minute above and does not attribute whole-machine launches to #249. Previous whole-machine receipt185.2/s is likewise not a controlled workload comparison.

### Hedgehog stayed open

Timed command: `pij-rs --json state pij-musical-hedgehog` (wall clock measured around the complete subprocess): **0.007981s**. Response:

```json
{
  "id":"pij-musical-hedgehog",
  "state":"idle",
  "liveness":"active",
  "pid":98769,
  "tombstonedAt":null,
  "session":"5256fe34-ff16-4676-b804-8fd87d75a87c",
  "sessionStatus":{
    "outcome":"not-found",
    "detail":"UNI-STATUS-TRANSCRIPT-NOT-FOUND: no transcript found for the session"
  }
}
```

Earlier same-seat state receipt was2.281s; earlier pre-#249 minute-scale daemon observation was~49.8%core. This command can be served by the new kept miss; it is a normal-use latency measurement, not an isolated cold lookup benchmark.

A follow-on5s `/usr/bin/sample 68910 5 1` still captures `seat_cards → seat_card → EventBus::all_matching → SqliteSpine::all_matching`, plus terminal-outcome JSON decode/drop work: the path #251 targets remains present. `status_incremental` samples show direct stat/fold work; no `walk_prep_root` symbol was captured. This short sample does not quantify the remaining CPU share or prove walks never occur. The large blocked daemon-log `__recvfrom` totals are waiting samples, not request/syscall counts.

Full local ping/ps/top/state receipts retained. I own the second reading after #251 merges and the daemon is bounced, with hedgehog left open.
